purpose: Make the P1C01 Gate 6/7 promotion evidence explicit so the project can move quickly without relabeling preparation or compile evidence as human/device acceptance.

chapter_playability: collision/nav blockers are absent on required path
canon-beat control handoff returns to player
save/load resumes the intended chapter/world state
target_device: Exact owner laptop identity: Intel Core i7-6498DU @ 2.50GHz, AMD Radeon R5 M330 (2039 MB reported VRAM), 8 GB RAM, Windows 11 Pro 64-bit; DX11 game renderer (Windows reports DX12, no DX12 Ultimate)
Same-build sustained 30 FPS goal: per-route measured min/average FPS, p95/p99 frame time, streaming hitches, process RAM and GPU/texture residency; no acceptance without real laptop execution
human_review: foliage wind naturalness and distraction check
return-to-control feel after locked canon beats

status_rules: COMPILE-TESTED requires a real UE4.27.2 compile result from the relevant source state.
PIE-TESTED requires chapter-specific PIE evidence from the relevant build.
DEVICE-TESTED requires observations from the target-class device/profile.
VISUALLY-ACCEPTED requires explicit human visual review for this chapter/build.
PERFORMANCE-ACCEPTED requires target-device measurements that meet the declared performance gate.
promotion_rule: No wider runtime-region promotion until the ProjectGovernor Gate 6/7 requirements are satisfied with real evidence. Preparation for later regions may continue in parallel.
evidence_boundary: Checklist only; P1C01 is not Gate 6/7 accepted by creation of this file.
